go-ahead.definition:
n a signal to proceed
n readiness to embark on bold new ventures
go-ahead.translation:
a. 前进着的
n. 进取心, 放行信号

go-ahead tone.translation: [计] 先行音信号, 响导信号

go-aheadism.translation: n. <口>进取的精神,主动性,积极性

go-and-return measurement.translation: [计] 环路测量, 回线测量

go-around.definition: n an approach that fails and gives way to another attempt
go-around.translation: n. 回合, 激烈争论

go-as-you-please.definition: s. not bound by rule or law or convention
go-as-you-please.translation: a. 不被规则所束缚, 随心所欲的

go-between.definition: n a negotiator who acts as a link between parties
go-between.translation:
n. 媒介者, 中间人
[法] 中人, 牵头人, 媒人

go-betweens.definition: n. a negotiator who acts as a link between parties
go-betweens.translation: n. 媒介者, 中间人( go-between的复数形式 )

go-by.definition:
n. A passing without notice; intentional neglect; thrusting
   away; a shifting off; adieu; as, to give a proposal the go-by.
go-by.translation: n. 轻视, 怠慢, 忽视

go-cart.definition:
n an enclosing framework on casters or wheels; helps babies learn to walk
n wheeled vehicle that can be pushed by a person; may have one or two or four wheels
n a small vehicle with four wheels in which a baby or child is pushed around
go-cart.translation: n. 小人车, 轻便马车, 手推车

go-carts.definition:
n. an enclosing framework on casters or wheels; helps babies learn to walk
n. wheeled vehicle that can be pushed by a person; may have one or two or four wheels
n. a small vehicle with four wheels in which a baby or child is pushed around
go-carts.translation: n. 早期的轻便马车；学走器；手推车；竞赛用的微型单座汽车

go-devil.translation:
n. (油管)清扫器, (油井)爆破器, (木材)运搬撬
[化] 清管器

go-fast.translation:
毒行公路（电影名）
快速追击（电影名）
走得快

go-faster.translation:
(go-fast 的比较级) 毒行公路（电影名）
快速追击（电影名）
走得快

go-faster stripes.translation: （可贴于车身侧面的）加速彩条

go-fining and resid-fining.translation: [化] 瓦斯油加氢精制及渣油加氢精制

go-getter.definition: n. someone whose career progresses rapidly
go-getter.translation: n. 积极能干的人, 志在必得的人, 能干的人

go-getters.definition: n. someone whose career progresses rapidly
go-getters.translation: n. <俚>非常积极能干的人, 老手( go-getter的复数形式 ); 志在必得的人

go-getting.translation: a. 野心的, 手段强硬的

go-go.translation:
a. 摇摆舞的, 无节制的, 乱窜的, 活跃的, 最时髦的
[经] 活跃信托, 敝开信托

go-gos.translation:
(go-go 的第三人称 -s形式) a. 摇摆舞的, 无节制的, 乱窜的, 活跃的, 最时髦的
[经] 活跃信托, 敝开信托

go-it-alone.translation: adj. 采取单独行动的；独立的；自给自足的

go-kart.definition: n. a small low motor vehicle with four wheels and an open framework; used for racing
go-kart.translation: n. 微型单座(竞赛)汽车

go-karts.definition: n. a small low motor vehicle with four wheels and an open framework; used for racing
go-karts.translation: n. 游戏用的无车体小型汽车, 其商标名( go-kart的复数形式 )

go-no-go-test.translation: [计] 是非测定, 合格-不合格测定

go-off.translation: n. 出发, 出门, 出发时间

go-slow.definition: n. a form of protest by workers in which they deliberately slow down in order to cause problem from their employers
go-slow.translation:
n. 怠工
[法] 消极怠工

go-slows.definition: n. a form of protest by workers in which they deliberately slow down in order to cause problem from their employers
go-slows.translation: n. 怠工( go-slow的复数形式 )

go-to.translation: （指对象）寻求协助的, 征询意见的

go-to-meeting.translation: a. 上教堂(或参加喜庆)穿戴的, 常去教堂的
